description: Analogue stereo oscillator: six phase-displaced sawtooth waves spread across a stereo pair

params.text: Sets the fundamental frequency of the oscillator core
Tunes the frequency finely around the setting of the COARSE knob
Drops the oscillator into subsonic frequencies
Sets the depth of frequency modulation from the FM input
Sets the FM input to linear scaling on the left or exponential on the right, where a full attenuator gives roughly a volt per octave
Sets the amplitude of the stereo and sigma outputs, through a soft clipping stage that holds them to about 10Vpp
Sets the depth of modulation from the level CV input
Sets the rate of the five triangle LFOs that phase modulate the sawtooth variants, down to a standstill anticlockwise
Sets the depth of modulation from the rate CV input
Sets how far those five LFOs displace the phase of the sawtooth variants
Sets the depth of modulation from the depth CV input

inputs.text: Sets the pitch at a volt per octave, summed with the COARSE and FINE knobs
Frequency modulation, scaled by the FM attenuator and applied linearly or exponentially by the LIN EXP toggle
Modulates the output level, scaled by its attenuator and summed with the LEVEL knob
Modulates the rate of the five phase modulation LFOs, scaled by its attenuator
Modulates the depth of phase modulation, scaled by its attenuator

outputs.text: Sawtooth waves 4, 5 and 6 summed, at the level set by the LEVEL knob
Sawtooth waves 1, 2 and 3 summed, at the level set by the LEVEL knob
All six sawtooth waves summed, at the level set by the LEVEL knob

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
